You will partner with merchants, sales team and internal teams to support you in your campaign development. Our team ambition is to be recognized as one of the most storied and prized marketing teams worldwide, our team is guided by six key principles: Own the Numbers – Drive growth and own the success metrics. Be Brand Proud – Embrace and champion the PayPal brand. Experience Matters – Prioritize customer experience in everything we do. Take Big Swings – Pursue bold and innovative ideas. Channel Marketing Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive channel marketing strategies that align with PayPal's business objectives and partner goals.
